protocol.py: 4 biology problems (2 errors, 1 warning, 1 note).

1. ERROR PIPETTE-RANGE: 0.195312 ul, 0.390625 ul, 0.78125 ul, 1.5625 ul and 3 more are below
what the p300_single_gen2 can measure (20 ul at least)
   line 67:  p300.transfer(stock_vol, tuberack["A1"], dst_plate[dst_well], mix_after=(2, 25))
   At line 67 the p300_single_gen2 is asked to draw 0.195312 ul, 0.390625 ul, 0.78125 ul,
   1.5625 ul and 3 more, below its minimum of 20 ul (this line did it 14 times). A pipette
   cannot measure less than its minimum: it draws the wrong amount, or nothing, and the
   volumes in this protocol only add up on paper. The simulator passes the move. Wells: tube
   A1 in slot 2.
   Affected: tube A1 in slot 2.
   Fix: Use a pipette whose range covers the volume (a p20 for 1 to 20 ul), or scale the
   reaction so every volume is at least the pipette's minimum.
   Source: Opentrons: pipette characteristics (volume ranges)
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/pipettes/characteristics.html
   Source: Integra: pipetting tips (work at 35 to 100% of nominal volume)
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/united-states/en/pipetting-tips
   [cad1b039691f]

2. ERROR PIPETTE-RANGE: 12.5 ul and 18.75 ul are below what the p300_single_gen2 can measure
(20 ul at least)
   line 69:  p300.transfer(water_vol, tuberack["A2"], dst_plate[dst_well], mix_after=(2, 25))
   At line 69 the p300_single_gen2 is asked to draw 12.5 ul and 18.75 ul, below its minimum

           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/united-states/en/pipetting-tips
   [c303675fbc61]

3. WARNING MIX-TOO-WEAK: Too few strokes to mix 14 wells: 2 × 25 ul in 25 ul
   line 69:  p300.transfer(water_vol, tuberack["A2"], dst_plate[dst_well], mix_after=(2, 25))
   At line 69 the tip mixes wells G11, G12, H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H6 and 6 more in slot 4 with
   2 strokes of 25 ul in a well holding 25 ul (this line did it 14 times). Fewer than 3
   strokes do not mix a well. A stroke of the whole well draws air at the bottom and foams
   the liquid. Integra draws over 80% of the well five times; three mixes gave 11.8% CV
   where twenty gave 1.7%. What the well holds is not at the concentration you calculated,
   and in a dilution series every later step inherits the error.
   Affected: wells G11, G12, H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H6 and 6 more in slot 4.
   Fix: Mix the well with about 80% of its volume (20 ul) at least 5 times: `mix(5, 20,
   well)`. A stroke of the whole well draws air; use no more than 90%.
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide
   Source: Integra: three serial-dilution protocols (over 80% of the volume, five times)
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applications/3-simple-and-proven-automation-protocols-serial-dilutions-assist-plus-pipetting-robot
   Source: Beckman AMPure XP instructions (mix with a tip volume just below the well volume)
           https://research.fredhutch.org/content/dam/research/hahn/methods/Agencourt%20AMPure%20XP.pdf
   Source: Esca Automation: serial dilution, a classic technique
           https://escaautomation.substack.com/p/serial-dilution-a-classic-technique
   Source: labautomation.io 3654: how to mix a bacteria sample enough
           https://labautomation.io/t/how-to-mix-bacteria-sample-enough/3654
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
           https://www.bioprocessintl.com/assays/automated-liquid-handlers-as-sources-of-error
   [b37f209e73f5]

4. NOTE NO-NEGATIVE-CONTROL: No blank on a dilution series: 16 wells of bsa
   line 67:  p300.transfer(stock_vol, tuberack["A1"], dst_plate[dst_well], mix_after=(2, 25))
   At line 67 the robot starts a dilution series of bsa in NEST 96 Deep Well Plate 2mL (slot
